# ferentin_endpoint_agent_approvals (Data Source)

List every AI-agent decision in the tenant (`ferentin_endpoint_agent_approval`), sorted by catalog slug. An agent with no decision is not listed: it falls through to `unapproved_agent_action` on the posture.

Every item carries `import_id`, the ID its resource's `import` block takes, and `managed_by`, who created it (`console`, `iac`, …). Filter on `managed_by = "console"` to find what Terraform does not manage yet.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every AI-agent decision in the tenant, sorted by catalog slug.
data "ferentin_endpoint_agent_approvals" "all" {}

output "blocked_agents" {
  value = [for a in data.ferentin_endpoint_agent_approvals.all.approvals : a.catalog_slug if a.action == "block"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `tenant_id` (String) Tenant to list. Defaults to the provider's.

### Read-Only

- `approvals` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--approvals))

<a id="nestedatt--approvals"></a>
### Nested Schema for `approvals`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) `report_only` (approved) or `block`.
- `catalog_slug` (String)
- `device_group_ids` (List of String) Null = every device, unless `scope_unreadable` is true.
- `import_id` (String) `<tenant_id>/<catalog_slug>`, for an `import` block.
- `last_modified_by` (String) Who wrote it last. Divergence from `managed_by` means it changed hands.
- `managed_by` (String) Who created it: `console`, `iac`, `cli`, `system` or `unknown`. Never changes.
- `scope_unreadable` (Boolean) True when the stored scope cannot be read, which puts the decision in force on no device.
